prompt: A darts player starts a leg of 501 on exactly 501 points. In one visit of three darts she scores treble 20, treble 19 and double 16. How many points does she have left?
explanation: Treble 20 is 60, treble 19 is 57 and double 16 is 32, so the visit scores 60 + 57 + 32 = 149. Subtracting from 501 gives 501 - 149 = 352.
